Method of Attack: Executes SQL commands against the appliance's database to steal hashed credentials of logged-in users
Establishes a reverse shell on the appliance for remote access
Acts as a backup malware process launched by startup script if primary malware exits or crashes
Checks for new firmware updates every 10 seconds and injects malware into upgrade package to persist through firmware upgrades; adds backdoor user 'acme' on upgrade file
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched vulnerabilities in SonicWall SMA devices
Indicators of Compromise: backdoor user 'acme' added on upgrade file
Version: 10.2.1.7 or higher (recommended target version to mitigate threat)
